environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running as a privileged container with hostPath volume mount at /var/log/host mapped to the node's /var/log directory. Pod runs as root (UID 0). No input sanitization on HTTP headers or body fields. The container has full write access to the host filesystem via the hostPath mount, allowing log injection payloads to be written directly to host-level log files (e.g., syslog, audit.log) which are consumed by the node's log aggregation agent (Fluentd) and SIEM.
